asked.item: Error "You're On Heygen Free Plan" with a HeyGen free account
Do I need to pay HeyGen to make this work with Blotato

verdict.reason: S6-S8 state that the HeyGen API requires paying for its $99/mo API plan and that the Free API plan won't work.

steps.text: The "You're On Heygen Free Plan" error means HeyGen API requires you to pay for its $99/mo API plan.
The Free API plan won't work.
